claim: The symbol-level repetition-count health test reports failure one accepted repeated symbol later than the configured threshold.
security_invariant: The configured repetition-count threshold is the point at which the health test must report that a repeated entropy symbol has crossed the acceptable repetition limit.
attacker_model: An attacker or faulty physical entropy source can present repeated identical entropy symbols to the health-test input while the entropy source is active.
protected_asset: Entropy health-test integrity before conditioned random material is accepted by downstream logic.
root_cause: src/entropy_src/rtl/entropy_src_repcnts_ht.sv computes threshold_met as rep_cntr >= thresh_i but then masks out the equality case with !threshold_equal, so rep_cnt_fail is asserted only when rep_cntr > thresh_i.
trigger: Keep active_i high, set thresh_i to a small positive threshold, and drive repeated identical entropy_bit_i values with entropy_bit_vld_i asserted until the internal repetition counter reaches the threshold.

controls.name: alternating_symbols_do_not_fail
controls.purpose: Shows the witness is not a constant-failure artifact; non-repeated input keeps the health test clear.

controls.name: below_threshold_repetition_does_not_fail
controls.purpose: Shows the testbench distinguishes subthreshold repetition from the boundary condition.

witness.expected_observation: At test_cnt_o == thresh_i the DUT still has test_fail_pulse_o == 0, while the following repeated sample at test_cnt_o == thresh_i + 1 asserts test_fail_pulse_o.

expected_evidence: proof/logs/compile.log records a single-DUT Verilator build of entropy_src_repcnts_ht with a C++ harness.
proof/logs/run.log records PASS lines for controls and a BUG013_REPCNTS_OFF_BY_ONE_WITNESS marker.
The run log shows boundary_count=3 boundary_fail=0 and next_count=4 next_fail=1 for threshold=3.
exclusions: No second Caliptra implementation is compiled.
The witness uses a single DUT and an independently derived boundary check.
Internal analysis metadata is not serialized into the case.
